title: Liquidate / Deleverage have no on-chain maintenance-margin precondition
root_cause: LiquidateTransLib/DeleverageTransLib never verify the target is below maintenance margin before force-resizing its position; deleverage only checks the signer is registered (no signature/nonce).
attacker_entrypoint: TYPE_LIQUIDATE / TYPE_DELEVERAGE (onlyTxBatcher) against a healthy account
out_of_scope_risks: relies on trusted operator/admin behavior (program trust model dependent)

severity_justification.worst_case: Faulty/malicious operator seizes healthy users' positions.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Operator-trust dependent; severity per the program's trust model.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: target is healthy (100 collateral, tiny long 1; risk <= value*FXP)
liquidation succeeds; healthy account's position force-closed (no 'not liquidatable' guard)

state_transition.after: target position force-closed (assets.length 0); forced trade settled against target

asset_delta: Healthy users' positions can be force-seized at operator-chosen price; over-seizure not blocked (with F-1).
false_positive_risks: severity/scope depend on the official program trust model
invalidating_conditions: program may treat operator/admin actions as out of scope

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: mitigates to operator-trust; on-chain protection of healthy users is still absent

triager_summary: Liquidate / Deleverage have no on-chain maintenance-margin precondition — PoC passing (PASS: a provably healthy account is force-liquidated with no maintenance-margin precondition).
vrt_category: Unsecure Design → Violation of Secure Design Principles (Liquidate/Deleverage have no on-chain maintenance-margin precondition; correctness relies entirely on the trusted off-chain batcher)
